named ", so the spawn answer can match it as a prefix.
- **Pull side:** `spawnPrompt` in `src/pull/pull_branch.go` builds its opening from that constant, so the two can't drift apart.
- **Hook side:** `src/modules/hooks/spawn.go` skips the session tag when the prompt starts with `HandOfItsOwn`, whether or not the `own` field is set.
- **Tests:** the existing table test in `src/modules/hooks/spawn_test.go` gained a row for a hand of its own with no `own` field, expecting no tag. I put it in the existing test because the fixture guard flags new fixture-building test functions. `src/pull/pull_branch_test.go` and `src/q/hand_test.go` cover the constant and the pull side.

Verification:
- `./RUNME.sh test src/modules/hooks/spawn_test.go` passes.
- `./RUNME.sh check` exits 0.

Choices and things to know:
- I matched the constant as a prefix of the hand line, not the whole line with the name. If the reference expects the full line, that's a one-line change.
- The pre-commit hook refused my first commit because it wants a test staged beside each changed package, so I added the two test files.
- The pull test is an in-package test marked as such, because it calls the unexported `spawnPrompt`.
- `src/scripts/pull-spawn.js` has the same hand-line string, and I did not change it. If the JavaScript path still runs anywhere, it has the same wording and would need the same treatment.
- The commit message ends with the Haiku co-author line from the attribution reminder. I did not open a PR.
